en: A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a leafy pergola walkway on a hillside terrace. A wooden railing runs along the left side overlooking a hazy valley, while a wall covered in vines lines the right. In the foreground on the right, a man sits leaning on a long wooden table with chairs beside it. Stairs and another pergola structure are visible in the background. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as the pergola on the Schlossberg in Graz.
